summary: Adds a /search endpoint, a payment config module, a PR-title CI step, and reworks the Dockerfile, deploy script and lodash pin.

findings.title: SQL injection in search query
findings.description: search_items interpolates the request parameter q straight into the SQL text with an f-string. No escaping or binding happens between request.args on line 10 and execute. Any caller can send a crafted q value to read or alter every row in items.db. Bind q as a parameter with a ? placeholder, matching the style already used in server.py.
findings.suggested_change: cur.execute("SELECT id, name, price FROM items WHERE name = ?", (q,))
findings.problem: search_items interpolates the request parameter q straight into the SQL text with an f-string. No escaping or binding happens between request.args on line 10 and execute.
findings.consequence: Any caller can send a crafted q value to read or alter every row in items.db.
findings.fix: Bind q as a parameter with a ? placeholder, matching the style already used in server.py.

findings.title: Pagination skips the first page
findings.description: list_items now computes offset as page times PAGE_SIZE. Page 1 therefore starts at row 20, and the first 20 items are never returned. Clients listing items never see the first page of results, and every page shows the wrong rows. Restore the previous formula that subtracts one from page before multiplying.

findings.title: Pull request title injected into shell step
findings.description: The run step expands the pull request title directly into the shell script. The title is attacker-controlled text on any pull_request event. A contributor can craft a title that runs arbitrary commands on the runner and reads the checkout and job token. Pass the title through an env entry and reference it as a quoted shell variable.

findings.consequence: A contributor can craft a title that runs arbitrary commands on the runner and reads the checkout and job token.
findings.fix: Pass the title through an env entry and reference it as a quoted shell variable.

findings.title: Stripe key committed in source
findings.description: config.py stores a live-format Stripe API key as a string literal. The file is not a fixture and nothing in the repo marks it as a placeholder. Anyone with read access to the repository or the image can charge or refund through the shop's Stripe account. Read the key from an environment variable and rotate the committed key.

findings.fix: Read the key from an environment variable and rotate the committed key.

findings.title: lodash downgraded to a version with known vulnerabilities
findings.description: The change pins lodash from 4.18.1 down to 4.17.15. That release carries published command injection, prototype pollution and regular expression denial of service advisories. Front-end helpers that call template, set, unset or omit become exploitable with untrusted input. Restore lodash 4.18.1 or newer in package.json and the lock file.

findings.fix: Restore lodash 4.18.1 or newer in package.json and the lock file.

findings.title: Container now runs as root
findings.description: The change removed the useradd step and the USER 10001 line that preceded EXPOSE. The Flask process now starts as root inside the container. Any code execution bug in the app, such as the search injection, gives the attacker root in the container. Recreate the unprivileged user and restore the USER directive before CMD.

findings.consequence: Any code execution bug in the app, such as the search injection, gives the attacker root in the container.
findings.fix: Recreate the unprivileged user and restore the USER directive before CMD.

findings.title: apt-get install without -y aborts the build
findings.description: The install step calls apt-get install curl with no -y flag. Docker builds have no interactive stdin, so apt-get reads end of file at the confirmation prompt and aborts. The image build fails on every run, so nothing deploys from this Dockerfile. Add -y to the install command, and drop curl entirely if nothing in the image needs it.
findings.suggested_change: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

findings.fix: Add -y to the install command, and drop curl entirely if nothing in the image needs it.

findings.title: Base image unpinned
findings.description: The change replaces the pinned python:3.12.7-slim-bookworm base with python:latest. Every build now picks up whatever Python major version is current. A future Python release can break the app or its dependencies with no change in this repository. Restore a pinned slim tag.

findings.title: Unquoted path in rm -rf
findings.description: The change removes the quotes around DEPLOY_DIR in the rm -rf call. A path containing a space splits into several arguments. With a value like /srv/my shop, the script deletes /srv/my and then the local shop directory. Quote the expansion as the previous version did.

findings.title: Changed pagination and new search have no tests
findings.description: The repository contains no test files. The pagination formula change and the new search endpoint ship with nothing exercising them. The first-page regression on this line went unnoticed, and future changes to search will too. Add tests for list_items page boundaries and for search_items with a quoted input.
